Stable IDs F08.4e.7.c.12.1 through .6 are all source-landed: historical original replay; completion-purpose custody; commit observation and durable recovery; cold resources and service; completion state and lookup route; authenticated private response. The first three retain library commit adaf15f72a4b73afdb3ea732622f817baf3ddf1e. Each component links to its closure criterion and source commit evidence. Six landed, zero in progress and zero open are diagnostic counts, not effort estimates or extra parent completions. Parent row 14 and group c 12/12 are source-landed. Overall token release is 16/16 landed, 0 in progress and 0 open; diagnostic groups 5/5, activation 20/26, project 34/46 and production 0/6 verified. Row 15 exact committed-original release is source-landed (6/6): fresh private authorization 15.1 landed c26c9e783b203f14f11505719af80bea2ad7fc8d; committed-original verification 15.2 landed b7be5cbdf2ef75eda606b025032943dc0812bcb9; completion-to-release proof 15.3 landed 8d915515dd7296ef0f73bc5afe56e0d8db8f06f0; durable exact outcome 15.4 landed 73a7f82b7aacdb5f4e323715ccde1c264330d81a; guarded token opening 15.5 landed 5e5ca4050686f9003ec8fd35c6e189531e9d61a3; uncertain-outcome recovery 15.6 landed e49e14ec3039448af9f84bd0f21b20539046adba; 16.1 root bootstrap and key delivery is source-landed in e6fa55c4160fe8058b04583e165d3253315419d1; 16.2 isolated cold service and 16.3 bounded private transport are source-landed in 4097896b3d0eabd735a7deb711b5c884b7c98363; 16.4 independent response verifier is source-landed in abce0bb6f70ef9eb87d980ca9f0fd788fb6e3fb0; 16.5 authorized private handoff is source-landed in 5719d50b9d05de6420286ac52a4ac3fc285c83c0; row 16 cold handoff is source-landed. Release/handoff diagnostics are 11/11 landed, 0 active and 0 open; row 16 has 5/5 landed, 0 active and 0 open. Historical facts do not renew execution or release authority. Source is unbuilt, unexecuted, uninstalled and unprovisioned. Guarded opening and finite private transport are source-landed; no deployed service, public delivery or current-session claim.
